package app

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"io"
	"math/rand"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"reflect"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

type echoImpl struct{}

func (echoImpl) Echo(ctx context.Context, req *Req) (*Res, error) {
	return &Res{Id: req.Id, Echoed: req.N, Tags: req.Tags, Big: int64(req.N) << 30, Note: req.Note}, nil
}

func serve(t *testing.T, opts ...any) string {
	t.Helper()
	mux := http.NewServeMux()
	if err := RegisterSServer(mux, append([]any{echoImpl{}}, opts...)...); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	srv := httptest.NewServer(mux)
	t.Cleanup(srv.Close)
	return srv.URL
}

func post(t *testing.T, url, body string) (int, string) {
	t.Helper()
	resp, err := http.Post(url+"/echo", "application/json", strings.NewReader(body))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer resp.Body.Close()
	data, _ := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
	return resp.StatusCode, string(data)
}

func TestClientServerRoundTrip(t *testing.T) {
	client := NewSClient(serve(t))
	note := "n"
	for _, req := range []*Req{
		{},
		{Id: "a", N: -3, Tags: []string{"x", "<y>"}, Note: &note},
		{Id: "emoji😀\u2028", Tags: []string{}},
	} {
		res, err := client.Echo(context.Background(), req)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if res.Id != req.Id || res.Echoed != req.N || res.Big != int64(req.N)<<30 || !reflect.DeepEqual(res.Note, req.Note) || len(res.Tags) != len(req.Tags) {
			t.Fatalf("got %+v for %+v", res, req)
		}
	}
}

func TestRequestBodies(t *testing.T) {
	url := serve(t)
	cases := []struct {
		name   string
		body   string
		status int
		id     string
	}{
		{"full", `{"id":"a","n":3,"tags":["x","y"],"note":"hi"}`, 200, "a"},
		{"empty body", ``, 200, ""},
		{"blank body", " \n\t", 200, ""},
		{"null", `null`, 200, ""},
		{"empty object", `{}`, 200, ""},
		{"case-insensitive key", `{"ID":"case","N":4}`, 200, "case"},
		{"duplicate key", `{"id":"a","id":"b"}`, 200, "b"},
		{"unknown fields", `{"zzz":{"a":[1,2,{"b":null}]},"id":"u"}`, 200, "u"},
		{"escapes", `{"id":"\u00e9\ud83d\ude00\n"}`, 200, "é😀\n"},
		{"pretty", "{\n  \"id\": \"p\",\n  \"tags\": [ \"a\" , \"b\" ]\n}\n", 200, "p"},
		{"truncated", `{"id":`, 400, ""},
		{"wrong type", `{"id":1}`, 400, ""},
		{"wrong number type", `{"n":"x"}`, 400, ""},
		{"fractional int", `{"n":1.5}`, 400, ""},
		{"overflow", `{"n":4294967296}`, 400, ""},
		{"trailing garbage", `{"id":"a"}x`, 400, ""},
		{"not an object", `[1]`, 400, ""},
	}
	for _, c := range cases {
		status, body := post(t, url, c.body)
		if status != c.status {
			t.Errorf("%s: status %d, want %d (%s)", c.name, status, c.status, body)
			continue
		}
		if status == 200 {
			var res struct {
				Id string `json:"id"`
			}
			if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(body), &res); err != nil || res.Id != c.id {
				t.Errorf("%s: id %q (%v), want %q in %s", c.name, res.Id, err, c.id, body)
			}
		}
	}
}

func TestRequestBodyLimit(t *testing.T) {
	url := serve(t, WithMaxRequestBodyBytes(32))
	if status, _ := post(t, url, `{"id":"`+strings.Repeat("a", 200)+`"}`); status != http.StatusRequestEntityTooLarge {
		t.Fatalf("status %d, want 413", status)
	}
	if status, _ := post(t, url, `{"id":"ok"}`); status != http.StatusOK {
		t.Fatalf("status %d, want 200", status)
	}
}

type stdReq Req

func mutate(r *rand.Rand, data []byte) []byte {
	out := append([]byte(nil), data...)
	if len(out) == 0 {
		return out
	}
	switch r.Intn(5) {
	case 0:
		out = out[:r.Intn(len(out))]
	case 1:
		out[r.Intn(len(out))] = "{}[]\",:0-.e \\tfn"[r.Intn(16)]
	case 2:
		i := r.Intn(len(out))
		out = append(out[:i], out[i+1:]...)
	case 3:
		i := r.Intn(len(out))
		out = append(out[:i], append([]byte{"{}[]\",:"[r.Intn(7)]}, out[i:]...)...)
	default:
		out[r.Intn(len(out))] = byte(r.Intn(256))
	}
	return out
}

func TestDecodeJSONMatchesTheReflectionDecoder(t *testing.T) {
	seeds := []string{
		`{"id":"a","n":3,"tags":["x","y"],"note":"hi"}`,
		`{"id":"\u00e9\ud83d\ude00","n":-2147483648,"tags":[]}`,
		`{"ID":"x","Tags":null,"note":null,"extra":[1,2,{"a":"b"}]}`,
		`{"id":"a","id":"b","n":1,"n":2}`,
		`{"tags":["a",null,"c"],"note":"n"}`,
		`{"id": "sp aces" , "n" : 7 }`,
	}
	r := rand.New(rand.NewSource(1))
	var inputs [][]byte
	for _, s := range seeds {
		inputs = append(inputs, []byte(s))
		for i := 0; i < 400; i++ {
			inputs = append(inputs, mutate(r, []byte(s)))
		}
	}
	for _, in := range inputs {
		var fast Req
		var slow stdReq
		ferr := fast.DecodeJSON(in)
		serr := json.Unmarshal(in, &slow)
		if (ferr == nil) != (serr == nil) {
			t.Fatalf("accept mismatch for %q: DecodeJSON=%v reflection=%v", in, ferr, serr)
		}
		if ferr == nil && !reflect.DeepEqual(Req(slow), fast) {
			t.Fatalf("result mismatch for %q:\nDecodeJSON: %+v\nreflection: %+v", in, fast, Req(slow))
		}
	}
}
